h1: Online Receipt Maker with Itemized Products
intro: Generate clear, itemized sales receipts with quantities, discounts, and tax breakdowns in seconds. 100% private and watermark-free.

howTo.title: How to Create an Itemized Receipt with Our Receipt Maker
howTo.subtitle: Generate professional itemized receipts for customers in three easy steps.

steps.title: Enter Merchant and Customer Details
steps.description: Add your store or business name, contact details, transaction date, and customer name or account number.
steps.tip: Include your sales tax or business registration number so business customers can claim tax deductions.

steps.title: Add Products and Itemized Services
steps.description: Itemize goods sold, quantities, unit prices, discounts, and applicable sales tax rates.
steps.tip: Toggle between Itemized, Cash, or Payment receipt modes depending on the transaction type.

steps.title: Download Receipt or Print Thermal Slip
steps.description: Download a clean PDF or click Print for an immediate paper receipt slip with an official 'PAID IN FULL' stamp.
steps.tip: Save receipts locally or email the downloaded PDF or PNG directly to your customer.

whatItMustContain.title: What a Sales Receipt Maker Document Must Contain
whatItMustContain.subtitle: Key elements required for valid expense reimbursement, retail accounting, and tax audits.
whatItMustContain.disclaimer: General information, not legal or tax advice. Check your local rules.

items.title: Merchant Business Name & Address
items.description: Clear identification of the seller or store, including physical location and contact phone or email.

items.title: Transaction Date & Receipt Number
items.description: Exact calendar date of payment and a unique sequential receipt number for bookkeeping reconciliation.

items.title: Line-by-Line Item Breakdown
items.description: Specific names of items or services purchased, individual quantities, and unit prices [Verify with official source: tax authority expense reimbursement documentation rules].

items.title: Taxes and Discounts Separated
items.description: Itemized tax rates (such as VAT or state sales tax) and any discounts subtracted from the subtotal.

items.title: Payment Method and Amount Received
items.description: Notation of the payment mode (Cash, Credit Card, Bank Transfer, or UPI) and confirmation of the total amount received.

items.title: Proof of Settlement Stamp
items.description: Official confirmation that the transaction is paid in full with zero remaining balance.

faq.title: Itemized Receipt Maker & Retail Slip FAQs
faq.subtitle: Common questions regarding receipt itemization, tax proofs, and POS formatting.

items.question: Why is an itemized receipt better than a credit card slip?
items.answer: A standard card slip only shows a total charged amount. An itemized receipt lists every product, quantity, and tax rate. Employers and tax authorities require itemized receipts to approve business expense reimbursements.

items.question: Can I use this tool for cash transactions?
items.answer: Yes. Switch to 'Cash' receipt mode to issue a clean payment voucher acknowledging cash received in hand without requiring detailed line items.

items.question: Is there a watermark on downloaded receipts?
items.answer: No. Online Invoice Creator generates 100% watermark-free documents on all downloads and prints.

items.question: Can I print receipts directly to a desktop or POS receipt printer?
items.answer: Yes. Click 'Print' to open your browser's native print dialog. You can print to standard desktop printers, thermal slip printers, or save directly as a PDF.
